learned_patterns.pattern: SAFE MODE has now persisted ~2 weeks. The refined root cause: the Signal Engine workflow_dispatch runs SUCCEED (07-09, 07-10 both 'success') but signal_summary.txt on the default branch has exactly one commit ever (06-30, the v1.72 feature commit) — no engine run has committed a refreshed summary. The break is in the engine's compute-to-commit/push of the lean summary, not the (already-removed) cron. Verify the workflow's git add/commit/push targets the default branch and the correct path; a 'successful' run with no file delta is the tell.

A second untracked agentic fill surfaced only via reconciliation: INTC was stop-sold 07-07 @ $109.01 (-15%) with no session writing it to memory. Same lesson as the JEPQ case — the broker is the source of truth (§5.1); always reconcile positions AND recent orders and fold in agentic fills. Over a multi-day session gap, expect the book to have moved.

INTC's ATR-wide 12.6% stop ($112.06) did not prevent a -15% realized loss — the exit filled at $109.01, below the stop, i.e. it gapped through. Wide ATR stops on high-vol single names (INTC ATR 7.64%) leave real gap risk between sessions for fractional positions with no live broker stop. Reinforces the CORE/ETF migration thesis (§13) and tighter stops on high-failure-risk names.

An organic LAB exit (INTC) did the rebalancing that force-selling is forbidden to do (§17.3): LAB dropped from 25.9% to 18.0%, back under its 20% Accumulation cap. Overweight tiers self-correct through natural stop-outs/profit-takes, exactly as the deposit-routing-over-selling rule intends. LAB is now cap-clear for a future NET/RXRX entry once signals are fresh.

Semis gave back the 06-30 quarter-end spike: SOXX -7.9% from entry (from +4.6%), NVDA/QQQ premarket red. The 06-30 'strong tape, neutral composites' divergence resolved toward the composites (which stayed NEUTRAL/BEARISH through the rip). A neutral/bearish quant blend during a sharp rally was, this time, the more durable read.
